newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers supported by crude gains.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers supported by crude gains.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were supported by crude gains and firm sentiment caused by anticipation that cargo prices will rise later Friday, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst prices were quoted at $127-$128 and 380-cst at $122-$123 per tonne, little changed from Thursday.
Shipowners appear relaxed with some saying that they have already covered their requirements and others said they could afford to wait.
MDO and gas oil quotes were steady at $230-$250 and $254-$257 respectively.
